evidence: Touches descriptor validation in `src/script/descriptor.cpp`, which directly governs descriptor key management and sanity checks in the wallet.
rationale: Fixes a sanity check bypass where Tapscript Miniscript descriptors containing duplicate keys differing only by parity were accepted as sane. Because Tapscript serializes keys on-chain as 32-byte x-only public keys, this allowed duplicate branches that 'violating BIP-379 non-malleability invariants' could permit third parties to malleate transactions without holding private keys.
